items.title: Oscar "Chicken" Henry Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: I thought Albert Warner's bell on that con, because it looked a little bigger, was it?

ctx.x: Well, the only bell larger than this is a symphony model bass trombone. This is a tenor trombone.
Yeah. I thought Albert Warner's bell on that con, because it looked a little bigger, was it? Maybe just...
It's about the same size. There's no difference in the bell. It's a nice bell.
